caption:
Weekend affirmations, written by Cella, approved by Cella.
Comment CLAIMED to take them home.
Link in bio.
by NMR

alt.1: Video with our own music, 6 seconds. Hot magenta field with pop stars in the corners. The title in 90s word-art, yellow gradient letters with a white and black outline and a hard shadow, bounces line by line. Cella, a small dark figure with a flat red crown, slides in lounging on a white sofa. Title: Weekend affirmations by Cella. Below: Comment CLAIMED to take them.
alt.2: Orange field, pop stars in the corners, the affirmation in huge blue word-art. Cella lounging on a white sofa with her eyes shut and her crown on, next to a sticker that says “© CELLA”. Affirmation number 1: “I cancel one plan and feel pure joy.”
alt.3: Lime green field, pop stars in the corners, the affirmation in huge pink word-art. Cella sitting on a white sofa with her crown on, next to a sticker that says “© CELLA”. Affirmation number 2: “I reply to the group chat with more than ‘lol.’”
alt.4: Orange field, pop stars in the corners, the affirmation in huge blue word-art. Cella lounging on a white sofa with her eyes shut and her crown on, next to a sticker that says “© CELLA”. Affirmation number 3: “I rest and explain it to nobody.”
alt.5: Lime green field, the affirmation in huge pink word-art, a big red rubber stamp that says CLAIMED, and Cella facing front with her crown. Affirmation number 4: “I remain the best-looking one here.” A red stamp reads CLAIMED. Comment CLAIMED to take it.
